title: Change name or contact details on a combatant registration
summary: You can change the contact details on your combatant registration online, or update your name by completing a specific form.
intro:
You can change the contact details on your combatant registration (address, email, mobile or telephone number) online. We’ll use these details to contact you about your registration.

To change your name, complete the Combat Sports Authority Change of name form.

If you're also registered as an industry participant or promoter, you'll also need to update your contact details on your industry participant and promoter registration, go to Change name or contact details on an industry participant and promoter registration.

### Changes to your MyServiceNSW Account.

Any changes you make to the contact details on your combatant registration will not automatically update on your MyServiceNSW Account.

You should continue using your MyServiceNSW Account email address to access the Combat Sports Registration System. If you need to update your MyServiceNSW Account email address, go to Manage your details with your MyServiceNSW Account.
what_you_need: The Combat Sports Authority Change of name form
One form of identity document that contains a photo and has been issued in your new name
A copy of one of the following change of name documents

how_to_steps.text: Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to change your contact details.
Gather the required information and documents.
Complete the Combat Sports Authority Change of name form.

faqs.q: Will changing my contact details on my combatant registration update my MyServiceNSW Account?
faqs.a: No, changes made to your combatant registration details will not automatically update on your MyServiceNSW Account. You should continue using your MyServiceNSW Account email address to access the Combat Sports Registration System.

faqs.q: What do I need to do if I am also registered as an industry participant or promoter?
faqs.a: You must also update your contact details on your industry participant and promoter registration.

faqs.q: How do I change my contact details online?
faqs.a: Select the 'Change online' button, log in to your MyServiceNSW Account, and follow the prompts to change your contact details.
